title: Lower bound for bounded edge decoding
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with $q$ labels, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1$, and choose a table of functions on the Boolean cube, each bounded between $-1$ and $1$, a default label, a vertex, one of its neighbors, and a coordinate. Suppose the coordinate has stable influence greater than $\varepsilon$ in the neighbor-averaged function at the vertex, and its image under the inverse constraint permutation has stable influence at least $\varepsilon/2$ in the table function at the neighboring vertex. Then the bounded decoding value on this directed edge is at least $\varepsilon^4/9$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with $q$ labels
